scenario: [LGRA.10.7]: a string with an interpolation site is rendered at the firing, so it is not a literal, and a `literal` kwarg given one is refused with DS_VALIDATE_DYNAMIC_IDENT_KWARG. `svc.set` declares `zone: String literal required`; rule `go` passes `zone: "room-{t.v}"`. PATH PINNED: `lgra_10_7_literal`'s `ex_string` arm in dsc.validate, which fails on a string `has_site` finds a site in.
rules_ds:
service svc.set:
    kwarg zone: String literal required
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: String key

rule go:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.set zone: "room-{t.v}" nocooldown
